query:
SELECT expires_at AS "expires_at!"
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    expires_at,
                    (SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY expires_at))::bigint AS freed
                FROM allowance_event
                WHERE key_value = $1 AND expires_at > $2
            ) AS charges
            WHERE freed >= $3
            ORDER BY expires_at
            LIMIT 1
